data.title: Explore Your Neighborhood Map
data.description: Use the compass rose to discover exciting new places all around the neighborhood!

challenges.instruction: Fly the helicopter from Aquarium to Train Station. Use the arrows to plan the trip, then press Land.
Fly the helicopter from Champ de Mars to School. Use the arrows to plan the trip, then press Land.
Fly the helicopter from Eiffel Tower to Library. Use the arrows to plan the trip, then press Land.
Fly the helicopter from Grocery Store to Aquarium. Use the arrows to plan the trip, then press Land.
Fly the helicopter from Library to Fire Station. Use the arrows to plan the trip, then press Land.

places.name: Library
places.blurb: You can sit in a cozy corner and read colorful picture books about magical adventures.

places.name: Grocery Store
places.blurb: You can pick out a yummy fresh croissant or a sweet treat for your snack time!

places.name: Fire Station
places.fullName: Brigade de Sapeurs-Pompiers de Paris - Caserne Grenelle
places.blurb: Brave firefighters keep the neighborhood safe and take care of big red trucks that go nee-naw!

places.name: Train Station
places.blurb: You can watch fast commuter trains zoom past on tracks to take people on exciting trips.

places.name: School
places.fullName: The Bilingual Montessori School of Paris
places.blurb: Kids here play games and learn how to speak two different languages with their friends!
